name: Krea 2 (Raw and Turbo)

lineage.family: Krea 2 (trained from scratch, per the official repo README)

purpose: Open version of Krea 2, an image model 'trained from scratch focused on creative and stylistic exploration' (official repo). Raw is the undistilled base for fine-tuning and LoRA training, Turbo an 8-step distilled checkpoint for fast text-to-image; train LoRAs on Raw and apply them on Turbo (README).

license.name: Krea 2 Community License (PDF)
license.notes: HF cardData: license other, krea-2-community-license, link to LICENSE.pdf in the repo. The PDF was not read, so commercial terms are unknown.

architecture.kind: diffusion transformer (about 13.1B in BF16: 26.28 GB file at 2 bytes per parameter, my arithmetic) with a Qwen3-VL-4B text encoder and the Qwen-Image VAE (ComfyUI file names)
architecture.why_this_design: Builder gives no architectural rationale in the README read; open_questions lists the technical report.

variants.format: safetensors BF16 (single file 26.28 GB; diffusers layout has transformer 26.3 GB + text encoder 8.88 GB + VAE 0.51 GB)

variants.notes: gated; 82.7k downloads, 2,037 likes; 8 steps, CFG off, 1k-2k resolution

variants.format: ComfyUI repack: fp8_scaled 13.14 GB, int8_convrot 13.49 GB, Turbo mxfp8 13.53 GB, Turbo nvfp4 7.67 GB; text encoder bf16 8.88 / fp8 5.24 / int8 4.86 GB
variants.notes: ungated, 4.5M downloads, 853 likes; the main distribution channel

pc-12gb.variant: Turbo fp8_scaled 13.14 GB + fp8 text encoder 5.24 GB
pc-12gb.notes: 18.4 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part streams from RAM (dense: decode is bandwidth bound); Turbo nvfp4 7.67 GB plus int8 encoder 4.86 GB would be the route; quality of nvfp4 not measured

pc-16gb.variant: Turbo fp8_scaled 13.14 GB + fp8 text encoder 5.24 GB
pc-16gb.notes: 18.4 GB file against 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part streams from RAM (dense: decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-24gb.variant: Turbo fp8_scaled 13.14 GB + fp8 text encoder 5.24 GB
pc-24gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (21.6 GB)

pc-32gb.variant: Turbo fp8_scaled 13.14 GB + fp8 text encoder 5.24 GB
pc-32gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (29.6 GB)

mac-16-24gb.variant: Turbo fp8_scaled 13.14 GB + fp8 text encoder 5.24 GB
mac-16-24gb.notes: 18.4 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.variant: Turbo fp8_scaled 13.14 GB + fp8 text encoder 5.24 GB
mac-32gb.notes: 18.4 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.variant: Turbo fp8_scaled 13.14 GB + fp8 text encoder 5.24 GB
mac-64gb+.notes: 18.4 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

other: GGUF conversions by third parties (e.g. Krea-2-Turbo-GGUF, 113k downloads)

strengths: aesthetics and stylistic range; huge LoRA/fine-tune ecosystem (dozens of Krea2 derivatives in the Sep-Nov HF sweep)
weaknesses: trained up to 1k resolution (Raw); NSFW/uncensored derivatives dominate community downloads
soft.maturity: Created 2026-06-18, so older than the September window, but not yet in this database; 2.0k likes on Turbo.

tona_fit.reason: A top-aesthetic open image model whose Turbo variant at fp8 (about 13 GB plus encoder) fits the 24 GB class and, with offload, 16 GB. Commercial terms unknown until the community-licence PDF is read; compare with qwen-image-2.1-turbo and z-image-turbo (permissive) before any offer.
